chunks: They do not esteem God as is rightly due to Him. The whole earth would be a fistful of His on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens would be rolled up in His right hand. Too immaculate is He and too high for what they associate with Him!
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about how God holds the earth and heavens on the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: This verse, often cited in Shia tafsir as a key proof for God's absolute sovereignty (Tawhid al-Sifat), emphasizes that human perception of Divine power is limited compared to the actual reality on the Day of Judgment. The imagery of the earth being 'grasped' and the heavens 'rolled up' in the right hand underscores God's capacity to recreate and judge, refuting the polytheists' misconceptions. It serves as a reminder that all creation is subject to His will, reinforcing the concept of Divine Omnipotence (Qudrah) central to Shia theological discourse.
